description: Catalogo completo de comandos Zavorth. package.json mantem apenas a superficie canonica; comandos legados e raros rodam via npm run command -- <nome>.

build.command: npm run runtime:build --silent && npm run surfaces:check --silent && npm run product:launchers:build --silent

dev.command: npx nodemon --watch src --ext ts --exec "npx tsx src/index.ts"

docs:site:build.command: node scripts/run-external-surface.mjs docs npm run build

docs:site:deploy.command: node scripts/run-external-surface.mjs docs npx vercel deploy --prod --yes

docs:site:preview.command: node scripts/run-external-surface.mjs docs npm run preview

nodes:host.command: npm run build --silent && npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-ops scripts/node-mesh-host.ts && node dist-ops/scripts/node-mesh-host.js

ops:backup.command: npm run build --silent && npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-ops scripts/ops-backup.ts && node dist-ops/scripts/ops-backup.js

ops:production:check.command: npm run build --silent && npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-ops scripts/ops-production-check.ts && node dist-ops/scripts/ops-production-check.js

ops:remote:keepalive.command: npm run build --silent && npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-ops scripts/ops-remote-keepalive.ts scripts/node-mesh-host.ts scripts/start-ai-gateway.ts && node dist-ops/scripts/ops-remote-keepalive.js

ops:remote:keepalive:stop.command: npm run build --silent && npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-ops scripts/ops-remote-keepalive.ts scripts/node-mesh-host.ts scripts/start-ai-gateway.ts && node dist-ops/scripts/ops-remote-keepalive.js --stop

ops:restore.command: npm run build --silent && npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-ops scripts/ops-restore.ts && node dist-ops/scripts/ops-restore.js

pack:add.command: npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node dist-ops/scripts/pack-manage.js add

pack:remove.command: npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node dist-ops/scripts/pack-manage.js remove

pack:status.command: npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node dist-ops/scripts/pack-manage.js status

product:launchers:build.command: npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-ops scripts/setup-v3.ts scripts/ops-go.ts scripts/ops-doctor.ts

profile:status.command: npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node dist-ops/scripts/pack-manage.js status --all

qa:bench.command: npm run qa:bench:boot && npm run qa:bench:runtime && npm run qa:bench:sidecars

qa:ci:core.command: npm run build --silent && npm run qa:command-center --silent && npm run qa:architecture && npm run architecture:hardening && npm run ops:qa -- --require-pass

qa:command-center.command: npm run qa:command-center-cockpit --silent && npm run qa:command-center-browser-preview --silent && npm run qa:command-center-real --silent && npm run qa:command-center-chat-visual --silent && npm run qa:command-center-composer-affordances --silent && npm run qa:command-center-response-cortex --silent && npm run ai-gateway:check --silent

qa:nexus-capabilities.command: npm run qa:vision-smoke && npm run qa:browser-agent && npm run qa:proactivity-loop

qa:phases:1-10.command: npm run qa:phases:1-6 && npm run qa:phases:7-10

qa:phases:1-11.command: npm run qa:phases:1-10 && npm run qa:phase:11

qa:phases:1-17.command: npm run qa:phases:1-11 && npm run qa:phases:12-17

qa:public-product.command: npm run qa:website-public && npm run qa:public-demo && npm run qa:first-run && npm run qa:external-docs && npm run qa:distribution-policy && npm run qa:release-bundle && npm run qa:feedback-loop

qa:remote-mesh-r9.command: npx jest tests/services/RemoteMeshNotebookScopedMcpServerService.test.ts --runInBand && npx tsx scripts/remote-mesh-notebook-scoped-mcp-server.ts --enable-docker-control --allow-docker-container zavorth-r8-test --allow-docker-action restart --use-docker-test-provider --self-test --docker-self-test --docker-control-self-test --use-generated-token --require-pass

qa:wave7-experimental.command: npm run qa:swarm-hierarchy && npm run qa:sandbox:aggressive && npm run qa:housekeeping-autonomous

release:diff.command: npm run cli:fast -- release diff previous latest

sdk:check.command: npm run sdk:ts:build && npm run sdk:python:check

security:doctor.description: Doctor read-only de postura de seguranca operacional

security:continuous.description: Monitor continuo de seguranca com baseline e drift detection

security:continuous:json.description: Monitor continuo de seguranca em JSON

security:baseline.description: Atualiza a baseline aprovada do monitor continuo de seguranca

security:preset:status.description: Mostra o preset operacional de seguranca ativo

security:preset:personal.description: Aplica o preset de seguranca para uso pessoal

security:preset:professional.description: Aplica o preset de seguranca profissional recomendado

security:preset:enterprise.description: Aplica o preset de seguranca corporativo

test:cross-surface.description: Comando canonico mantido por defork gate: test:cross-surface

test:external-agents:heavy-shards.command: npm run test:external-agents:shard -- 3/16 --testTimeout=30000 && npm run test:external-agents:shard -- 8/16 --testTimeout=30000 && npm run test:external-agents:shard -- 11/16 --testTimeout=30000 && npm run test:external-agents:shard -- 12/16 --testTimeout=30000 && npm run test:external-agents:shard -- 15/16 --testTimeout=30000

test:transports:smoke.command: npm run build --silent && npx tsc --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --outDir dist-remote-transport scripts/remote-transport-doctor.ts && node dist-remote-transport/scripts/remote-transport-doctor.js

website:build.command: node scripts/run-external-surface.mjs website npm run website:build

workspace:check.command: npm run runtime:check && npm run identity:public && npm run defork:check && npm run surfaces:check && npm run architecture:boundaries && npm run architecture:hardening && npm run architecture:lazy-loading && npm run architecture:event-first && npm run architecture:contracts && npm run architecture:activation && npm run architecture:activation-ledger && npm run architecture:activation-replay && npm run architecture:retention
